issuer.summary: Named developer leadership and a disclosed service counterparty provide accountability, but product-specific token issuer/redemption obligor, corporate continuity/authorization, holder insolvency priority and financial assurance remain unresolved. Retain Issuer 5.0 provisionally pending executed holder-rights/registration/assurance evidence; this is not a freshly validated rating. Old audit, investor-prestige and mint-authority arguments do not justify Issuer: code powers belong on Contract & Admin, credit/warranty on Backing and queue capacity on Liquidity & Exit. Equal provisional marks reflect shared service-counterparty/legal-disclosure gaps, not automatic propagation or a proven common issuer; sUSDai agent enforcement adds a distinct unresolved legal exposure.
issuer.summary_source: Public primary terms (September 25), name-change disclosure (October 28), current product and CHIP docs, October-revised Barkr disclosure; checked November 4, 2026. Documentary evidence only; no new live authority, reserves or loan verification.
facts: CHIP Foundation is the Cayman service counterparty; USD.AI Inc. is the disclosed developer, formerly Permian Labs. Corporate continuity and authorization remain unverified.
USDai and sUSDai product-specific issuer/redemption obligors and holder insolvency priority remain unresolved. CHIP issuer and Paxos customer rights do not fill those gaps.
USDai docs describe PYUSD backing and permissionless conversion with AML controls; current contract gates/capacity are unmeasured. Completed PYUSDx migration is not established.
issuer.producer_note: November 4 documentary correction, scores retained provisionally. Original whole-report and live-observation clocks remain; old mint-route/audit-based Issuer rationale withdrawn. Public adoption requires normal consumer publication review.
